title: Difficult times in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation of farmers
description:
From Harvest Public Media

Tadeo Ruiz Sandoval

Many farmers across the U.S. are reaching retirement age. But lately, increasing volatility and sky-high prices in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation to take over.
